definitions.gloss: a man's help; male hands; male labor
definitions.explanation: A man as a source of work or help, especially for heavy jobs, or a man raising a family. Most often heard in {男手|おとこで}が{足|た}りない and {男手|おとこで}{一|ひと}つで.

examples.japanese: {男手|おとこで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: We need a man's help here.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男手|おとこで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなかった→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: On moving day we were short of men to help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くして→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{男手|おとこで}⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: After losing my mother, my father raised the three of us on his own.

notes:
⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (man) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand, worker), as in ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {男手|おとこで}⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise (children) as a single father
- ⟦{女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ→女手一つ：33159_onnadehitotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise (children) as a single mother
- {男手|おとこで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ / ほしい: to be short of / want men's help

USAGE:
Talk of {男手|おとこで} for heavy work can sound old-fashioned; ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧ (hands, workers) and ⟦{力仕事|ちからしごと}→力仕事：32433_chikarashigoto⟧ (physical labor) are neutral.
